title: Paul Prodigy - TSU
htmlContent:
Independent Rap Artist Paul Prodigy from Arlington Texas has released a new single called "TSU," a sound impossible to ignore with intense sound, taking over your speakers with every second the song plays. The rhyming is vicious, with every line being delivered with high energy to grab and shake the listener to up.

The single "TSU" is all about Paul's school Tarleton State University in a small city in texas called Stephenville. The production is intense, the vocal approach is powerful, and the lyrics don’t slack to create a hard edge masterpiece.
